purpose: Teach: エコロジー/ダーウィン/コンドーム/左脳/王宮/地球人/父兄/中尉

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、エコロジー運動の戦後史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper on post-war history of environmental movements was interesting.
lines.style: Warm, observant opening. Steady eye contact. Slight pause before the topic—noticing him carefully. Not interrogating, genuinely curious about his work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、ダーウィン進化論の現代解釈を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about modern interpretations of Darwinian evolution theory.
lines.style: Quiet correction, gentle but direct. Eyes meeting hers. Not defensive—clarifying what he actually studied. A slight swallow before speaking, like gathering precision.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、コンドーム普及率の保健研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, I recall you researching contraceptive prevalence rates for a public health study.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured pacing. Slight tilt of her head—genuinely trying to remember. Warm but a touch uncertain, giving him space to clarify gently.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、左脳機能の言語処理を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I focused on language processing in the left hemisphere of the brain.
lines.style: Soft but clear correction. A faint half-smile—patient, not frustrated. Methodical in his tone, like he's learned to reorient conversations without blame.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 英国王宮の伝統儀礼を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: The traditions and ceremonial practices of the British royal court—that was your focus, wasn't it?
lines.style: Engaged but probing gently. Eyebrows slightly raised, inviting confirmation. Warm curiosity, like she's testing whether she's finally got it right.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、地球人と宇宙人の交流SF研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No—I actually researched science fiction studies on interaction between humans and extraterrestrials.
lines.style: Quieter this time, almost apologetic for the correction. Eyes down briefly, then back to hers. Slightly weary but kind—this has happened several times already.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、父兄会の教育参加を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your paper on parental involvement in school education decisions—that was the one, wasn't it, Ren?
lines.style: Gentler now, sensing something. Slower pacing. A small, knowing pause before his name. She's listening more than asserting now.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦前の海軍中尉の階級制度を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No, I wrote about naval rank hierarchies in the pre-war military.
lines.style: Quieter, resigned. Eyes away. A breath that holds something unspoken. The patience is still there, but underneath it, a small exhaustion.
